# TCR Security

> > TCR Security provides professional penetration testing, red teaming, and cybersecurity assessment services with expertise in web application, API, and infrastructure security.

TCR Security is a cybersecurity firm specializing in penetration testing and vulnerability assessment across web applications, APIs, and network infrastructure. The team includes security experts like Komal Yadav, Devendra Singh, Rupesh Kumar, Jitesh Yadav, and Nishtha Jain, delivering comprehensive security services aligned with OWASP Top 10 and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.

## Key Topics

- Penetration Testing
- Web Application Security
- API Security
- Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
- SQL Injection
- Red Teaming
- OWASP Top 10
- Vulnerability Assessment
- Ethical Hacking
- Network Security
- Infrastructure Testing
- File Upload Vulnerabilities
- MITRE ATT&CK Framework
- Security Assessment
- CTF Platforms

## Security Services

- [Web Application Penetration Testing](https://tcrsecurity.com/service/web-application-penetration-testing): Web app pentesting service covering OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
- [API Pentesting](https://tcrsecurity.com/service/api-security): API security testing service for vulnerability assessment
- [Infra Penetration Testing](https://tcrsecurity.com/service/infra-penetration-testing): Infrastructure pentesting service for network and system security
- [Case Studies](https://tcrsecurity.com/case-studies): TCR Security pentesting and red teaming case studies portfolio

## Security Methodology & Strategy

- [Why Pentesting is Necessary for an Organization](https://tcrsecurity.com/why-pentesting-is-necessary-for-an-organization): Pentesting essentials with MITRE ATT&CK framework for security assessment
- [What is Red Teaming?](https://tcrsecurity.com/what-is-red-teaming): Red teaming strategy guide for simulated attacks and threat assessment

## Web Vulnerabilities & Exploits

- [Cross Site Scripting](https://tcrsecurity.com/cross-site-scripting): XSS vulnerability guide covering reflected, stored, and DOM-based attacks
- [SQL Injection Attacks](https://tcrsecurity.com/sql-injection-attacks-understanding-detecting-preventing-and-practicing): SQL injection guide covering detection, prevention, and attack types
- [File Upload Vulnerabilities](https://tcrsecurity.com/file-upload-vulnerabilities): File upload security flaws: RCE, web shells, and validation bypass
- [API Pentesting](https://tcrsecurity.com/api-pentesting): API security testing guide covering RESTful APIs and SQL injection risks
